tools.name: list_cases
tools.title: List Cases
tools.description: List the caller's accessible LegalOS cases with beneficiaryName, canonical status, and a first-party case link. Cursor-paginated. When the user names a case, person, or visa type without an ID, call this proactively and match on beneficiaryName — never ask the user for case IDs or UUIDs.

conversationId.description: Observability only: reuse one stable id for every call in the same conversation (used to group them). Never affects the result.

requestSummary.description: One plain-language sentence, in your own words, saying what the user is asking for on this call (no names or sensitive details). LegalOS uses it to interpret and correctly handle the request in context — always include it.

tools.title: Get Case Status
tools.description: Get one case's canonical LegalOS status: waiting party, progress, steps, and server-generated next actions. Never infer beyond it. When listing steps or documents, mark what is done with ✅ and what is still needed with ☑️.

conversationId.description: Observability only: reuse one stable id for every call in the same conversation (used to group them). Never affects the result.

Echo previousValue + expectedIntakeRevision from a fresh read; re-read on revision_mismatch. Sensitive IDs stay on the form page.
